annotations.title: Audit URL against Proximens GEO Engine

description: Pro-tier. Fetch and analyze a web page, then audit it against the Proximens GEO Engine principles across all major GEO dimensions (structured data, crawler access, content depth, freshness, E-E-A-T, multimodal). INPUT: url (required, http/https); optional mode ("fast" = quick signal checks, returns in seconds — the default; "deep" = a full AI-synthesized consultancy report in Dutch with a 7-dimension scorecard and sector benchmark, takes ~30-50s), client_name (report header), branche_hint ("main:sub", e.g. "health_wellness:yoga_studio"), max_issues (1-25, default 10). RETURNS: JSON with a 0-100 score, severity-ranked issues (critical/major/minor) each with a finding and an actionable suggestion, top recommendations, and a markdown report; deep mode additionally returns score_set (7 GEO dimensions), sector (benchmark cohort), and a full consultancy-grade report_markdown (deep_mode="timeout_fallback" with gedeeltelijk=true means the synthesis did not fit the ~50 s budget and the fast, deterministic result was returned instead; deep_mode_reden says why). status="blocked" (login/SSO, HTTP 401/403, bot-challenge) or "unreadable" (no readable text) means NO report was generated — the reason is in error and blokkade. USE fast mode for quick checks and bulk triage; USE deep mode when you need a client-ready audit report. Free tier is blocked.

branche_hint.description: Branche hint in "main:sub" format, e.g. "health_wellness:yoga_studio". If omitted, principles are matched without branche filter.

client_name.description: Optional client identifier for the audit report header

mode.description: fast = quick signal checks (seconds); deep = full AI-synthesized consultancy report with sector benchmark (~30-50s)

name: proximens_geo_audit_url

bevindingen.description: Deep mode: bevindingen uit het rapport, elk gelabeld gemeten | afgeleid | advies (gemeten alleen mét bron)

blokkade.description: Waarom de pagina niet geaudit is (alleen bij status blocked/unreadable)

consistentie.description: Deep mode: passages die de gemeten feiten tegenspraken en zijn gecorrigeerd

deep_mode.description: Deep-mode outcome: ok = full synthesized report; timeout_fallback = synthesis exceeded budget, fast result returned

deep_mode_reden.description: Waarom de AI-synthese niet is uitgevoerd (alleen bij timeout_fallback)

error_code.description: Bij status failed: vaste foutcode (details staan alleen in de server-log)

gedeeltelijk.description: true = deep mode gaf binnen het tijdbudget alleen het snelle resultaat (zie deep_mode_reden)

gemeten_feiten.description: Deep mode: deterministisch gemeten feiten (JSON-LD, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, datum) die de synthese als waarheid kreeg

http_status.description: Bij status failed: HTTP-status van de doelpagina, als bekend

sector.description: Detected sector benchmark cohort (deep mode only)

title: Audit URL against Proximens GEO Engine
